description: Wendy is a Sky Dragon Slayer who draws her power from the air around her. She excels at healing magic, and is able to cure even wounds inflicted by a dragon. After the Nirvana incident, Wendy became a member of Fairy Tail.Although she has a shy personality, Wendy has grown familiar with her guildmates and enjoys her time with them.While she does not enjoy combat, Wendy's strong heart lets her fight with all her strength for the sake of her guildmates.
summon: I'll always be by your side. Don't be afraid.
fusion: The power of a dragon...lies within me. This is to protect our very own guild!
evolution: My job is to support everyone! But...if a time comes when I must fight...that's when I become the Sky Dragon!
